messages.subject: lavaan Error
parts:
I am getting the following error:

Error in lav_syntax_parse_rhs(rhs = rhs.formula[[2L]], op = op) : 
  lavaan ERROR: I'm confused parsing this line: ~~56

What does that mean?

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: lavaan Error
parts:
Working out what an error message means in any R package is often a challenge. Often it means "You've made a mistake" and there isn't really much better information than that. However, here it seems to be saying that there's a problem with the place that says "~~56".

Can you post your code, so we can see it?

Jeremy

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan Error
parts: > lavaan ERROR: I'm confused parsing this line: ~~56

The right hand side of the "~~" operator seems to be a number (56). It
should be a variable name (and they must start with a character).

Yves.
